vault.note: Our best-selling hoodie, in black so the GINCOR red swoosh and white wordmark stand out. The everyday layer for fabrication, paint and assembly bays.

tvest.note: Five-point tear-away vest in orange, close to GINCOR red. It breaks away if it snags on a hoist, chassis or trailer frame instead of pulling the wearer in.

tee.note: Cotton CSA traffic tee. In a shop with welding and grinding, cotton is the safer choice over polyester, which melts when sparks land on it.

tt4.note: Long-sleeve cotton traffic tee: arm coverage near spatter and sharp steel edges, plus CSA visibility for people moving bodies through the yard.

hoodie.note: Hi-vis traffic hoodie for the yard crew moving finished dump bodies, trailers and snow equipment, where visibility matters most.

rk_sp24.note: Red Kap industrial work shirt in black, built for industrial laundering: a crisp uniform for leads, QC and service techs that holds up to shop grime.

rk_sp24#w.note: Women's cut of the same black Red Kap shirt, so leads and techs at every location look like one team.

rk_ct10.note: Twill action-back coverall for paint prep, undercoating and hydraulic installs: one-piece protection that keeps the mess off and still carries your logo.

forge.note: Forge heavyweight hoodie: a thick, warm layer for a cold shop floor in February, when the bay doors keep opening for trucks.

cs_l00880.note: Fortress 440 GSM water-repellent hoodie: sheds rain and wash-bay spray for anyone going between the shop and the yard all day.

cs_l00915.note: Cotton canvas vest with sherpa lining: tough canvas stands up to steel and sparks better than nylon, and keeps the core warm while arms stay free to work.

cs_l00910.note: Big Red cotton canvas bomber, a durable winter jacket for the shop that suits a company that builds heavy steel. It looks the part in the GINCOR colours.

tj2.note: CSA softshell traffic jacket for yard staff, delivery drivers and the people handing over finished units to customers, in any weather.

freezer.note: Quilted hi-vis jacket for winter yard work: insulated without bulk, so people can still climb into cabs and run equipment.

tj3.note: 3-in-1 winter traffic jacket for the snow and ice side of the business: shell, liner or both, for crews testing and delivering plows in real winter.

cs_h08000.note: Cuffed knit toque with the GINCOR mark: cheap, worn all winter across every location, and an easy add to any jacket order.

cs_h08205.note: Trucker snapback in black with the red-and-white GINCOR mark. The shop-floor cap that also works at the dealer counter.

st_aquacooler24.note: 24-can cooler backpack for long shifts and service calls. A useful safety-milestone gift for the crew.

vest.note: Our best-selling quilted vest in black, which shows the red swoosh and white GINCOR wordmark at their sharpest. The layer for dealer visits and the sales floor.

c3_88181.note: Origin performance piqué polo: lightweight and wicking for long trade-show days on the trade-show floor. Our preferred value polo.

c3_88181#w.note: Women's Origin polo in matching black, so every sales and dealer-support person on the booth is in the same uniform.

softshell.note: Balmy softshell, one of our top picks: the jacket reps wear walking a dealer lot or a customer's yard for a handover, sharp and weather-ready.

softshell#w.note: Women's Balmy softshell in matching black for the sales and dealer-support team.

cbc_advantage_polo.note: Premium recycled cotton-blend polo for leadership and key-account reps: the polo for meetings with fleet buyers and municipalities, where first impressions count.

cbc_advantage_polo#w.note: Women's Advantage polo in black, for leadership and key-account staff.

st_cruise.note: Cruise premium softshell: a step up in finish for dealer principals and senior reps. It also works as a thank-you gift for top-performing dealers.

st_cruise#w.note: Women's Cruise softshell in matching black, for senior staff or dealer gifts.

st_treeline.note: Treeline quarter-zip: a smart layer for trade-show booths and office days, and a dependable years-of-service gift across 28 locations.

st_treeline#w.note: Women's Treeline quarter-zip in the same black, for booth staff and office teams.

chill.note: Chill puffy vest, one of our top picks: warm for outdoor demo days and winter snow-equipment shows without looking like shop gear.

chill#w.note: Women's Chill vest in black, so the outdoor event team looks consistent.

at_sonic.note: Red and black mesh-back trucker in GINCOR's own colours. A strong giveaway at shows and dealer events, and the kind of cap customers keep wearing.

st_nautilus35.note: Waterproof 35L duffel in bold red, close to the GINCOR swoosh. A standout dealer incentive or trade-show draw prize that carries your brand for years.

st_saltspring.note: Salt Spring 16 cooler bag: a premium thank-you for fleet customers taking delivery of a new dump body or trailer.

st_roadwarrior.note: Computer backpack for territory reps travelling between dealers and customer yards. A professional piece that keeps the brand visible on the road.

crewtee.note: Cotton tee in black for booth crews and event volunteers: the lowest-cost way to put GINCOR on a lot of people at a show.
